name: CrowdSec Stats
description: Active bans and scenario breakdown from CrowdSec IPS

displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="md" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Title order={4}>CrowdSec</Title>
    <Badge color={data.healthy ? "green" : "red"} size="sm" variant="light">
      {data.healthy ? "Healthy" : "Offline"}
    </Badge>
  </Group>
  <Group grow>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" p="sm">
      <Stack gap={2} align="center">
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Total Bans</Text>
        <Text fw={700} size="xl" c="red">{data.total_decisions}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" p="sm">
      <Stack gap={2} align="center">
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Community</Text>
        <Text fw={700} size="xl">{data.community_bans}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
    <Card withBorder radius="md" p="sm">
      <Stack gap={2} align="center">
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Local</Text>
        <Text fw={700} size="xl" c="orange">{data.local_bans}</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  </Group>
  <Stack gap="xs">
    <Text size="sm" fw={600}>Bans by Scenario</Text>
    {data.scenarios.map((s, i) => (
      <Group justify="space-between" align="center" gap="sm">
        <Text size="xs" style={{ width: 110 }}>{s.label}</Text>
        <Progress value={(s.count / data.total_decisions) * 100} size="sm" color={["red","orange","grape","blue","cyan","teal"][i % 6]} style={{ flex: 1 }} />
        <Text size="xs" fw={600} style={{ width: 50, textAlign: "right" }}>{s.count}</Text>
      </Group>
    ))}
  </Stack>
</Stack>
